text: どうも　ちまちまと　そだてる　のは　にがてだぜ！

structure.jp: ちまちまと　そだてる　のは
structure.en: raising them bit by fussy bit

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. そだてる　のは = 'raising them (is...)'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes your statement at the listener. にがてだぜ = 'I'm no good at it, man!'.
